scripts.//dev: Drops inherited proxy variables for the same reason the root dev scripts do: this process talks to Supabase directly (JWKS at startup, Postgres for every request), and an editor-injected proxy that is no longer listening turns that into a startup failure that reads like Supabase is down.
scripts.dev: env -u HTTP_PROXY -u HTTPS_PROXY -u ALL_PROXY -u SOCKS_PROXY -u http_proxy -u https_proxy -u all_proxy -u socks_proxy node --import tsx src/main.ts
